title: Japanese Yen: Yen vulnerable after BoJ communication – MUFG
summary: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny notes that the Bank of Japan’s 25bp hike to 1.25% fell short of hawkish market pricing, triggering an initial Yen sell-off as expectations for larger moves proved overdone.

title: Swiss Franc: Consolidation holds below 0.8300 against US Dollar – UOB
summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang notes USD/CHF remains in a consolidation phase after a sharp rally, with intraday trading expected between 0.8225 and 0.8265.

title: ECB’s Lagarde: We'll decide on rates meeting by meeting
summary: European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde said during the European trading session on Friday that the decision on interest rates by the central bank will be meeting by meeting.
